name: Dweomerden Shelter
body:
School abjuration; Level wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one tent that holds up to ten Medium creatures
Duration 24 hours (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You ward the interior of the affected tent against extreme temperatures and adverse weather.

Whenever a creature is fully contained within the tent, that creature gains the benefits of an endure elements spell and +4 bonus on saving throws against severe weather.

Special: A character with the Dweomerden wizard archetype can prepare the Dweomerden shelter spell in one of his bonus spell slots.
